name: Query Studio
author: Centrix HIS Helper Tools
summary: Run MongoDB shell queries against the connected site, with an audit trail of every query.
description: A query editor for the connected Centrix database: find, aggregate, count, distinct and explain in mongo shell syntax, with tree, table and JSON results, lookups of referenced records, saved queries, export, and censoring of patient personal data. Every query is recorded in the Query Studio audit log.
features: Query editor with run selection, explain and cancel
Tree, table and JSON results with page and whole-collection search
Lookups of referenced records and Basic Data popup
Saved queries and CSV / Excel export
Censoring of patient and organisation personal data
Audit log of every query, export and setting change
requires: SQLite for the audit log and saved queries
